CustomField.description: Written by: a human, in this record, from measurement. Read by: AAO_Extract.inventorySpec, sent as output_config.effort on STAGE 1 ONLY. Blank falls back to AAO_Effort__c. It exists because session 74 measured the stage that shares that field and found the sharing was the defect: at effort=high the stage 1 read spent 7,500 of 7,500 output tokens on thinking and emitted ZERO content, three sessions after the shared value was first blamed on size. max_tokens bounds thinking and content together, so on this stage effort is not a quality dial, it is what decides whether any content is produced at all. Part of what produced a given result and therefore part of what has to be recorded alongside it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stage 1 only. Blank falls back to Effort. Measured, never guessed: at high the read spent its entire output budget thinking and returned no inventory.
CustomField.label: Inventory Effort
